summaryText:
Hi,

Here is the end-of-day summary for 8 September 2026.
Total work logged: 8h 25m.

Tickets worked on today:

AEME-6282 — [For approval] Redeem rewards on impacted orders
  Customers exploited multi-tab checkout to redeem and cancel rewards points on 22 UAE orders. 18 remediated via PC-48490. 4 remain with insufficient GCRM balance — partial redemption script prepared under PC-53503. (1h 45m)

AEME-6499 — 
  Five stuck UAE orders investigated. Four progressed to COMPLETED after stock availability resolved. One order AE260812-57849665 remains stuck at SHIPPING_REQUESTED — awaiting warehouse shipment confirmation for the main consignment. (25m)

AEME-6500 — 
  Six UAE orders investigated for SC+ and shipping issues. Three resolved. Two remain stuck at SHIPPING_REQUESTED — one awaiting warehouse confirmation, one pending SMC remediation under PC-53305. Payment captured successfully on all. (1h 0m)

AEME-6535 — 
  SUBS team requested 18 new SubscriptionData columns on the UAE PROD Daily SC+ report. Groovy script created under PC-53535, reviewed by Vaibhav Jain. Awaits deployment to update gcc-PROD-Daily-SC-ReportScript via HAC console. (25m)

AEME-6540 — [PROD] | Manual Chargeback || 07-Sep
  Two UAE trade-in clawback orders failed because Checkout.com declined the card payment for the clawback amount. Both orders are COMPLETED. Clawback process stuck — awaits customer payment method update before manual re-trigger.

PC-5 — 

PC-53305 — 
  Reusable PC ticket for SMC re-registration remediation of order AE260819-63130115 from AEME-6500. Resets stale SC+ policy, clears UPDATE_ERROR ExternalService to NEW, and retriggers consignment process. Awaits approval and execution.

PC-53535 — 
  Modifies UAE PROD Daily SC+ report to add 18 new SubscriptionData and payment mode columns U-AL. Script reviewed by Vaibhav Jain. Deployment requires updating ScriptingJob content via HAC console. Rollback: revert script to version 44. (25m)

PC-53689 — Add Affiliate_Name and Multistore_VerificationCode columns to SA Sales Report
  Adds Affiliate_Name and Multistore_VerificationCode columns to SA Sales Report Groovy script. Handlers use native Order.getAffiliateName() and Order.getVerificationCode(). Script complete and attached. Deployment: update Script item in HAC, run cronjob to verify. (1h 0m)

SAME-3960 — 
  Return blocked for SA screen repair order because GCIC service order status exceeded cancellable window ST030. Hybris correctly blocks return per TokoCreateReturnRequestController validation. Options: contact GCIC for status rollback, enable config, or manual refund via HAC. (2h 30m)

TKME-2308 — 
  17 TR-region stuck orders investigated via HAC DB verification. 5 already resolved. Remaining 12 across 5 root causes: FI connection errors, GetMobil NPE, refund failures, WMS issues, and returns. No reusable PC ticket for FI or refund retrigger found. (20m)

TKME-2311 — 
  Master data creation for TR store C750_007_31536 — HARK MUHENDISLIK, Antalya. ImpEx generates POS, UserGroup, Address, and OmnichannelDealer following PC-53353 pattern. PC-53498 created, reviewed, approved, and executed. Reporter confirmed data created correctly. (35m)

Open tickets:

PC-53689 [Approved-ES] — Add Affiliate_Name and Multistore_VerificationCode columns to SA Sales Report
  Todo: Approved by D2C
Please validate in production, then update the comments and also monitor the performance impact as well.

AEME-6282 [In Progress] — [For approval] Redeem rewards on impacted orders
  Todo: Hi ~@email ,

 

According to the API details, the requested amount exceeds the customer's current balance.

The custome

PC-53503 [To do] — Redeem rewards points (partial) for 4 AE orders - AEME-6282
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAME-3958 [QA Server Review] — Sales Report - Additional Columns
  Todo: Awaiting QA review.

PC-53529 [To do] — [SAM-24720] Create DB cleanup cronjobs for SMI cluster
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

AEME-6540 [In Progress] — [PROD] | Manual Chargeback || 07-Sep
  Todo: Continue investigation.

SAM-24720 [Code Review] —  Update or create Cronjob for autocleanup
  Todo: Hi ~@email,
   Please find below details : 
SAP incident : https://me.sap.com/cases/002075129500011086542026/overview
Sa

Thanks,
Aryan
